It looks like you've pasted one of my earlier replies back to me, and I don't have any conversation before this message. Something may be auto-copying responses, or the clipboard may be holding the wrong text.

You don't need to format anything. Just type what you want in a sentence or two, even something rough like "help me write an email to my landlord" or "fix this code," and I'll take it from there.
